code:
julia = Compile[{{z0, _Complex}}, Module[{z = z0, n = 0}, While[Abs[z] < 2 && n < 120, z = z^2 + (-0.8 + 0.156 I); n++]; n]];
Colorize[Image[Rescale[Log[1. + ParallelTable[julia[x + I y], {y, 0.95, -0.95, -0.0064}, {x, -1.6, 1.6, 0.0067}]]]], ColorFunction -> "SunsetColors"]

code:
With[{eu = CountryData["Europe"]},
 Graph[DeleteDuplicates[Sort /@ Flatten[Table[UndirectedEdge[c, #] & /@ Intersection[CountryData[c, "BorderingCountries"], eu], {c, eu}]]],
  VertexLabels -> Automatic]]
